outages.headline: Ukraine Strikes Lukoil's Volgograd Refinery as Drone Attacks Resume
outages.summary: Ukraine has struck one of Russia’s biggest refineries, Lukoil’s Volgograd processing facility, the Ukrainian forces said on Friday as they resumed attacks on Russian refining capacity. The Volgograd refinery, which has the capacity to process 300,000 barrels per day (bpd) of crude, produces gasoline, diesel, and jet fuel. It was hit by Ukrainian forces, Ukraine’s Security Service said in a Telegram post on Friday. The hit was “successful,” Ukraine said, without offering details as to the extent of damage. outages.headline: South Korea refiners eye Venezuelan crude amid Hormuz disruptions
outages.summary: South Korea’s four major oil refiners are exploring imports of Venezuelan crude oil as Middle East conflicts disrupt shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, according to a Korea Petroleum Association official.
